trap.label: falso cognato
trap.why: Actually em inglês significa "na verdade", não "atualmente" (falso cognato).

fix.wrong: The fee is high, therefore we help.
fix.right: The fee is high; therefore, we help.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com consequently: “He studied, so he passed.”
Reescreva com in addition: “Also, they offer a mentor.”
rewrite.answer: In addition, they offer a mentor.

rewrite.prompt: Una com nevertheless: “It was hard. They finished.”
rewrite.answer: It was hard; nevertheless, they finished.
